'''Tirsia Lek''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
At some point in [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] prior to the [[Occupation of Bespin]],<ref name="Timing">Lando Calrissian is still Baron Administrator of Cloud City during the events of ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'' and therefore it must occur prior to the Empire's takeover of Cloud City</ref> Tirsia Lek was an agent of the Imperial Security Bureau investigating [[Marus Grayson]] for the sale of contraband outside [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] space. When it was discovered that Grayson would be auctioning off the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a valuable [[Corusca gem/Legends|corusca gem]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], Lek traveled to Bespin posing as '''Zekra Fol''', a representative of a non-existent mining consortium fabricated by the ISB. Lek had little interest in the gem itself, but wanted the price driven higher for the item to further incriminate her assignment.<ref name="TJoY" />
